_doc: THE COVER'S WORDS. print/cover/make_cover.ps1 draws print/cover/cover-<format>.svg from these in the house style (the generator is septet_LGMF_2026's, copied whole 2026-10-08). `title` and `subtitle` are each ONE string or a LIST of lines (drawn stacked, centred); `subtitle` may be left out. `vertical`: "centre" centres the whole block on the sheet's height; leave it out for the house place (first baseline 27.1 % down). Edit, then run:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File print/cover/make_cover.ps1   and then:  node scripts/render_cover.js
